bayts.text: O my master, O Chosen, O Possessor of bounty, may He bless you Who guided you as a support,
with the purest blessing and peace, that bestows on me steadfastness and less sleep,
in the Family, the Companions and the followers; and may He increase me in knowledge with following.
O my master, O Elect, O Possessor of the heights, may He bless you Who is exalted and lofty,
with the purest blessing and peace beyond number, that drives lasting succour to me,
in the Family and the Companions; and may He hold back from me what is forbidden, and bestow on me the gaze toward You.
O my master, O Chosen, O Possessor of guidance, may He bless you of Whom you asked guidance,
with the purest blessing, that drives to me all that I have desired forever, greeting with peace,
with a peace upon all the Family and your Companions, the pearls and gems.
O my master, O Followed One, O you who journeyed by night, may He bless you Who called you to the night journey,
with the purest blessing, that bestows on me triumph, that I may be your neighbour without journeying,
with a peace upon all the Family and the Companions, with whom tomorrow shall be my destination.
O my master, O best of those sent to the creation of the God of the worlds, Possessor of favours,
may He bless you and grant you peace forever, with the Family, the Companions and whoever devoted himself to worship,
with the purest blessing from Him — exalted be He — with peace, that makes my Ṭūbā (Touba) good for me, with the Abode of Peace.
May your Lord, the All-Hearing, bless you and grant you peace, with all your Family and the Companions,
with the purest blessing that bestows your guidance on me, with a peace that subjects your enemies to me.
O best of every begetter and what he begot (Qurʾān 90:3), may He bless you Who is exalted above having a child,
greeting with peace, together with the elect worshippers, as He removed toward others than me (evil) and my woe,
without return to me, unto the Gardens; and through you He has made my heart clear forever.
O best of those sent to the best community (Qurʾān 3:110), may He bless you and spare you distress
a Lord Generous, Beneficent, Who is majestic, and Who has exalted your immense rank,
greeting you with peace beyond all number, with the Family and the Companions; and He has increased my succour.
O you for whose truthfulness the moon was split (Qurʾān 54:1), may He bless you Who commanded following you,
greeting you with peace with honour, in the Family and the Companions, without break;
and through you He forgave all my sins, and expiated for me all that was upon me.
O Chosen, O Selected, O Elect, may He bless you Who guided you and elected (you),
greeting you with peace in the noble Family and your radiant Companions; and He has led the aim to me,
and toward others than me He held back prohibition and misery, and what deprives me of ascent.
And He bestowed on me abundance of recitation, remembrance and prayer, with sweetness.
And He bestowed on me knowledge and deeds, refinement and perfection.
O my master, O my longing, O my shield against every evil forever, O my garden,
may a Benefactor bless you Who bestowed graces through you upon us and perpetuated the graces,
and all that you longed for He led to you without hardship, and it yielded.
greeting you with peace, O Chosen, and He drove to me all that I choose,
in this world and the next, through you, (making me) possessed of safety from the reckoning and from blame.
And He made time good for me as I love, and held back from me forever what I do not love.
And through you He has been for me and drove my need to me, until I become the gladness of non-Arabs and Arabs.
And He joined me to the trustworthy Companions, and led the wishes to me without reckoning.
And He remitted my sin and effaced my faults, and tamed for me every ungrateful one who bolted.
And He granted me that this poem be a healing for me and for the community, wherever it is unveiled.
And He held back from me all calamities through it, and drove to me through it the distinctions.
For He — exalted be He — has power over that, and is worthy to answer the call of the caller (Qurʾān 2:186).
I addressed Him with gratitude and praise, since through you He has banished my toil from me.
O You for Whom asking any other than Him is for me misguidance, since You have been for me with generosity, O Possessor of majesty!
O Allah, O Near (Al-Qarīb), O Answerer (Al-Mujīb), bless him through whom You answer,
our master possessed of miracles, with peace, with the Family and the Companions, who removes the darkness.
And be for me forever, and be with me, and be for me the One Who drives beyond my aim, with "Be".
And make by his standing my life clear for You, through him, with abundant rewards.
